Beyond Six Flags (BSF)

Vinings, GA · Road

Beyond Six Flags (BSF) is a road group ride in Vinings, GA. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Atlanta Cycling store, Vinings. About 50 miles, steady but unpleasant, in the host's words.

For visitors

The 50-mile figure is from a third-party directory. The group splits at about mile 13.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: steady but unpleasant, in the host's words. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @theatlantapeloton the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Beyond Six Flags (BSF) group ride

A steady, hard Saturday road ride southwest out of Vinings, rotating among four routes through the month. A group of 20-plus splits at mile 13, with the faster riders ramping up.
